title: Orgulous
html_source:
Orgulous means proud or haughty (or disdainful); here it seems to be used as an adverb.

I remember from my high school Spanish class that orguloso means proud! But the etymology does not mention this:
From Middle English orgulous, orgeilous, from Old French orgueilleus, orgoillus (“proud”), from orgoill, orgueil (“pride”), from Old Low Frankish *urgol (“pride”). Cognate with Old High German urguol (“excellent”), Old English orgel (“pride”). More at orgul.
